cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.14)
project(OpenJDK11u LANGUAGES C CXX ASM)

# Load autoconf-generated config (from spec2cmake.sh)
set(CMAKE_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/cmake_config.cmake")
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CONFIG_FILE}")
    include("${CMAKE_CONFIG_FILE}")
endif()

# Global settings
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 99)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 98)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# JNI headers include path (generated by Make javac phase)
# jni.h/jni_md.h are in modules_include, javah headers are in headers/
set(JNI_HEADERS_BASE "${JDK_BUILD_DIR}/support/headers" CACHE PATH "Generated JNI headers")
set(JNI_INCLUDE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/${JDK_BUILD_DIR}/support/modules_include/java.base" CACHE PATH "jni.h location")
set(JNI_INCLUDE_DIR_LINUX "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/${JDK_BUILD_DIR}/support/modules_include/java.base/linux" CACHE PATH "jni_md.h location")

# Output directory for native libraries — align with Make JDK image layout
set(JDK_IMAGE "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/jdk")
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${JDK_IMAGE}/lib" CACHE PATH "Library output")
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${JDK_IMAGE}/lib" CACHE PATH "Archive output")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${JDK_IMAGE}/bin" CACHE PATH "Executable output")

# Suppress warnings about unused variables from JDK flags
add_compile_options(-Wno-unused-command-line-argument)

# Required defines for Linux JNI native code
add_compile_definitions(_GNU_SOURCE _REENTRANT LINUX)

# JNI public headers — needed by ALL native libraries
include_directories(
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/modules_include/java.base
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/modules_include/java.base/linux
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/java.base
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/java.instrument
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/java.management
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/java.prefs
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/java.security.jgss
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.attach
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.crypto.cryptoki
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.crypto.ec
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.jfr
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.management
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.management.agent
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.net
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/build/linux-x86_64-normal-server-slowdebug/support/headers/jdk.security.auth
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/hotspot/share/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/hotspot/os/posix/include
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/share/native/libjava
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/unix/native/libjava
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/share/native/libfdlibm
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/share/native/libnet
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/unix/native/libnet
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/java.base/share/native/libjli
)

# === Phase 0: HotSpot JVM (must build before Phase 1 launchers) ===
add_subdirectory(src/hotspot)

# === Phase 1: Independent Libraries ===

# libfdlibm — static math library (java.base)
add_subdirectory(src/java.base/share/native/libfdlibm)

# libjli — JVM Launch Infrastructure (java.base)
add_subdirectory(src/java.base)

# libjsig — signal chaining (java.base)
add_subdirectory(src/java.base/unix/native/libjsig)

# libverify — bytecode verifier (java.base)
add_subdirectory(src/java.base/share/native/libverify)

# === Phase 4: Remaining JDK Native Libraries ===
add_subdirectory(src/java.instrument/native)
add_subdirectory(src/java.management/native)
add_subdirectory(src/java.prefs/native)
add_subdirectory(src/java.security.jgss/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.attach/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.crypto.cryptoki/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.crypto.ec/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.hotspot.agent/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.management/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.management.agent/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.net/native)
add_subdirectory(src/jdk.security.auth/native)

# === Phase 5: Launcher Executables ===
add_subdirectory(launcher)
